description: A closed black hard case sits on the tabletop in front of you, with a tan backdrop behind it. The right hand reaches forward to the latch and lid while the left hand steadies the front edge, then the right hand lifts the lid open; next the right hand reaches into the foam insert and removes a small yellow plush toy and sets it on the table, then takes out a black oval case and places it down nearby while the left hand hovers and does not touch the items.
